46:

51:                 example: "'a--b--c' | split column '--'",

56:                 })])),

62:                         "column1" => Value::test_string("a"),

65:                 })])),

79:                 ])),
80:             },

82:                 description: "Split a list of strings into a table, ignoring padding",

85:                     Value::test_record(record! {
86:                         "column1" => Value::test_string("a"),
87:                         "column2" => Value::test_string("b"),
88:                     }),

90:                         "column1" => Value::test_string("c"),
91:                         "column2" => Value::test_string("d"),

100:     }

105:         stack: &mut Stack,

144: struct Arguments {
145:     separator: Spanned<String>,
146:     rest: Vec<Spanned<String>>,
147:     collapse_empty: bool,
148:     has_regex: bool,
149: }
150: 
151: fn split_column(
152:     engine_state: &EngineState,
153:     call: &Call,
154:     input: PipelineData,
155:     args: Arguments,
156: ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
157:     let name_span = call.head;
158:     let regex = if args.has_regex {
159:         Regex::new(&args.separator.item)
160:     } else {
161:         let escaped = regex::escape(&args.separator.item);
162:         Regex::new(&escaped)
163:     }
164:     .map_err(|e| ShellError::GenericError {
165:         error: "Error with regular expression".into(),
166:         msg: e.to_string(),
167:         span: Some(args.separator.span),
168:         help: None,
169:         inner: vec![],
170:     })?;
171:     let positional: Vec<String> = args.rest.iter().map(|f| f.item.clone()).collect();
172:     let engine_state_owned = engine_state.clone();
173: 
174:     input.flat_map(
175:         move |x| {
176:             args.split_column_helper(&x, &regex, &positional, &engine_state_owned, name_span)
177:         },
178:         engine_state.signals(),
179:     )
180: }
181: 
182: impl Arguments {
183:     fn split_column_helper(
184:         &self,
185:         v: &Value,
186:         separator: &Regex,
187:         positional: &[String],
188:         engine_state: &EngineState,
189:         head: Span,
190:     ) -> Vec<Value> {
191:         let table = &engine_state.get_config().table;
192:         let mut extra_columns = usize::from(table.show_empty)
193:             + table.padding.left.min(2)
194:             + table.padding.right.min(2);
195:         extra_columns = match table.mode {
196:             TableMode::None => 0,
197:             _ => extra_columns,
198:         };
199:         extra_columns = extra_columns.saturating_add(usize::from(engine_state.file.is_some()));
200: 
201:         if let Ok(s) = v.coerce_str() {
202:             let split_result: Vec<_> = separator
203:                 .split(&s)
204:                 .filter(|x| !(self.collapse_empty && x.is_empty()))
205:                 .collect();
206: 
207:             // If they didn't provide column names, make up our own
208:             let mut record = Record::with_capacity(
209:                 split_result
210:                     .len()
211:                     .saturating_add(extra_columns)
212:                     .saturating_add(usize::from(
213:                         engine_state.file.is_some() && split_result.is_empty(),
214:                     )),
215:             );
216:             if positional.is_empty() {
217:                 let mut gen_columns = vec![];
218:                 for i in 0..split_result.len() {
219:                     gen_columns.push(format!("column{}", i + 1));
220:                 }
221: 
222:                 for (&k, v) in split_result.iter().zip(&gen_columns) {
223:                     record.push(v, Value::string(k, head));
224:                 }
225:             } else {
226:                 for (&k, v) in split_result.iter().zip(positional) {
227:                     record.push(v, Value::string(k, head));
228:                 }
229:             }
230:             vec![Value::record(record, head)]
231:         } else {
232:             match v {
233:                 Value::Error { error, .. } => {
234:                     vec![Value::error(*error.clone(), head)]
235:                 }
236:                 v => {
237:                     let span = v.span();
238:                     let span = Span::new(span.start, span.end);
239:                     vec![Value::error(
240:                         ShellError::PipelineMismatch {
241:                             exp_input_type: "string".into(),
242:                             dst_span: head,
243:                             src_span: span,
244:                         },
245:                         span,
246:                     )]
247:                 }
248:             }
249:         }
250:     }
251: }

Done. Added the `-n`/`--number` flag to `split column`, mirroring `split row`:

- `crates/nu-command/src/strings/split/column.rs`:
  - Added a `number` flag (`-n`, `SyntaxShape::Int`, "Split into maximum number of columns") to the signature
  - Captured `max_split` in both `run` and `run_const`, added it to `Arguments`
  - The helper now uses `regex.splitn(&s, n)` when the flag is given, so the nth column holds the remainder of the string
  - Added an example: `'a--b--c' | split column -n 2 '--'` → `column1: a`, `column2: b--c`

Verified in the container: `split_column` integration test (`to_column`, including the `-n 3` case), `repl::test_table_operations::split_column`, and all `split*` unit/integration tests pass (22 tests, 0 failures). No test files were modified.
